7.description: Fixed an issue where Ready to Strike buff from Heavyweight would not be consumed by Cleave.
Demolishing Strike now deals 165% weapon damage, up from 150%. It now deals 35% reduced damage to players, from 30%.
Increased the spell power scaling of Crusader Strike (One With the Light) and Divine Storm (One With the Light) by 4%.

The tentacles summoned by Whispers of the Old Gods can now increase your spell damage by 15% of your Spirit for 15 seconds. Also renamed their spells, increased their damage slightly, and fixed some issues where they could eat effects like Pain and Suffering.
Fierce Mind now increases your spell power (both spell damage and healing power) by 3% of your Spirit. It previously increased healing power by 2% of your Spirit.
Faith Rekindled now increaases the duration of Renew by 1 second per tick, down from 1.5 seconds.
Fixed an issue where some Epic Mystic Enchants were usable on weapons.

Removed the cast time of Concussion Blow (Stormhammer), and its damage and scaling has been increased. The duration of Stormhammer buff has been increased to 6 seconds, up from 4 seconds, and the threat from Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning is increased to 100%, up from 50%. Stormshield from Stormhammer now lasts 8 seconds, up from 6 seconds.
Fixed an issue where Concussion Blow (Stormhammer) would not go in warrior spell book tab.
Fetch Me Their Bones! now triggers from dealing damage with Arcane Shot, Steady Shot, Raptor Strike, Mongoose Bite, Counterattack, and Wing Clip.
Fixed an issue where Heavyweight wouldn't properly give the proper attack speed and damage increase when Ready to Strike is active.
Fixed an issue where Demolishing Strike would not benefit from all Mortal Strike damage and cooldown modifiers.
Fixed an issue where Blood Rain sometimes would not properly increase the damage of bleeds.
Fixed an issue where Ice Lash would stop having guaranteed critical strikes after some time.
Fixed the tooltip of Twisted Mind to correctly state that it increases your spell power by 1 per level.
Demolishing Strike now deals 35% reduced damage against players, from 30%.

1.description: Fixed an issue that could cause Critical Block not to reduce the damage properly when critically blocking.
Fixed a tooltip issue with Hasty Exorcism, where it was showing the wrong cooldown reduction when enchanted on gear.
Fixed an issue where Ready to Strike buff from Heavyweight would not be consumed by Cleave.
Conflagrate now deals 5% reduced damage against players. It previously did not have a PvP modifier.
Mortal Strike now deals 140% weapon damage, up from 130%. It now deals 45% reduced damage to players, from 40%.
Mutilate now deals 135% weapon damage, up from 130%.
Gag Order now also increases the threat of your Shield Slam by 5/10%.
Anticipation now also grants 3/6/9/12/15% block value.
Thunder Clap now deals 60% increased damage while wielding a two-hander, up from 40%.
Improved Victory Rush now increases threat by 33/66/100%, up from 20/40/60% increased threat.
Savage Defense now reduces the damage taken by an amount equal to 35% of your attack power, up from 25%.
Increased the Armor bonus of Thick Hide (Feral talent) to 7/14/20%, up from 5/10/15%. In addition, this talent now also increases stamina by 1/2/3%.
Wrecking Crew no longer requires Battle Stance.
Fixed a bug causing Divine Storm to do less damage than stated by the tooltip. Also increased the weapon damage of Divine Storm to 135%, up from 130%.
Increased the duration of Netherwind Presence to 10 seconds, up from 8 seconds.
Increased the damage of Wrath by 4%.
Emberstorm now reduces the cast time of Incinerate by 0.06 seconds per point, up from 0.05 seconds.

Increased the weapon damage of Backstab to 230%, up from 215%, and the weapon damage of Ambush to 305%, up from 285%. In addition, the bonus damage of Backstab and Ambush has been increased by 8%. Ambush now deals 20% reduced damage to players, from 15%.
Increased Chain Lightning's base damage by 8%, and spell power scaling by 4%
Increased Lightning Bolt's base damage by 8%, and spell power scaling by 4%
The Anticipation Capstone effect now increases shield block value by 20%, up from 15%. In addition, the tooltip now clarifies that the effect cannot occur more than once every second.
Natural Reaction now restores 15 rage when dodging an attack, up from 10 rage.
Improved Faerie Fire now increases the critical strike chance of your Druid damage spells by 2% per rank, up from 1% on targets afflicted by Faerie Fire.
Increased the damage of Immolate by 7%.
Righteous Vengeance can now proc from Hammer of Wrath.
Fixed an issue where Revitalize would not work with Healing Touch.
Iceblock now gets canceled automatically when casting Stealth.
Changed Seed of Corruption's tooltip to no longer state that that one Corruption spell per Warlock can be active on any one target.
The Spirit Tap, Moonglow and Holy Concentration Spirit buffs do not stack.
Holy Concentration now increases Spirit by 10/20/30% instead of only increasing the mana regeneration from Spirit.

Moonglow now reduces the mana cost of Starfire, Wrath, Healing Touch and Regrowth and gives a chance when casting these spells to increase your Spirit by 10/20/30% (from 4/7/10%) for 8 seconds. It no longer increases your spell haste.
New Capstone: Living Spirit - With the final rank of this talent, your Rejuvenation now heals for an additional 50% on targets below 50% health.
The Meditation capstone effect now increases your spell critical strike rating by 15% of your Spirit.
Improved Moonkin Form now increases your spell damage by 4/8/12% of your Spirit, up from 3/6/9%.
Improved Spirit Tap now increases your spell critical strike rating by 10/20% of your Spirit, up from 8/15%.
Spirit Tap now increases your Spirit by 10/20/30%, from 15/30/45%.
New Capstone: Student of the Mind - With the final rank of this talent, your spell damage is increased by 15% of your Spirit.
Student of the Mind now increases Spirit by 5/10/15%, up from 4/7/10%.
Tranquility can now heal anyone in your raid instead of being limited to party members. It will still target a maximum of five allies per tick, and will prioritize allies with lower health.
Fixed an issue where Bloodrage would not grant the appropriate amount of rage.
Fixed an issue where Deep Freeze damage would not be affected by Molten Fury talents or Mystic Enchant.
Mongoose Bite, Counterattack and Wing Clip will now scale with ranged attack power increasing effects such as Hunter's Mark.

6.description: Fixed an issue where Fierce Blow would sometimes stop triggering on bosses with spells.
Fierce Blow now pierces 50% of absorbs on the target.
[Karazhan] [Chess Event] Fixed a bug where chess pieces spells would target incorrect units.
[Karazhan] [Chess Event] Fixed a bug where Cheat Spells would sometimes not deal damage to the correct chess pieces.
[Karazhan] [Netherspite] Fixed a bug where Netherspite sometimes would be permanently immune to taunt effects.

5.description: Fixed an issue where Uther's Strength wouldn't proc properly.
Fixed an issue where some items were not giving the stats shown on the tooltip.

0.description: Fixed an issue within the battleground que logic that could cause uneven teams.
Fire Fire Fireball should correctly trigger now.
Fixed an issue where Shaman Weapon enchants like flametongue and frostbrand was doing far less damage than intended.
Fixed an issue where Blood and Guts disembowel was doing far less damage than intended.
Fixed an issue where rogue poisons would deal far less damage than intended.
Whitemend set now has 115 Item Level up from 105.
Normalized the item level of Primal Mooncloth set, it now has 115 item level across the 3 pieces, this brings the average item level from 113.3 to 115.
Pending Restart: .character list command will now have a "Next Page" button.

5.description: All level 70 Darkmoon Cards now have 115 item level.
Fixed a bug that was introduced two days ago that caused item level to calculated be wrong.

6.description: [The Mechanar] [Nethermancer Sepethrea] Corrected an issue where Arcane Blast would knock player straight up into the air instead of knocking the target back in an arc on Heroic and Mythic difficulty.

2.description: Fixed a bug where creatures would sometimes getting stuck when channelling spells.

1.description: Pet Avoidance will now work on Cleave-like abilities.

0.description: Upscaled Mythic BoE items from mythic dungeons slightly!
Pending Restarts: The Torch Juggler achievement can now be completed.

6.description: [Frost Lord Ahune] Corrected an issue where Formula: Enchant Weapon - Deathfrost couldn't drop.
[Frost Lord Ahune] Corrected an issue where Scorched Stone (Pet) couldn't drop.
[Frost Lord Ahune] Corrected an issue where Frostscythe of Lord Ahune couldn't drop.
[Frost Lord Ahune] Ahune will now drop a Necklace and a Cloak in his chest.

[Karazhan] [Shade of Aran] Frost Bolt, Fireball and Arcane Missiles now have unlimited range. This allows Shade of Aran to kill player that are on another level of Karazhan then his room and prevents AFK player from keeping the zone in combat.

5.description: Tabard of Brilliance and Tabard of the Defender should now be of Artifact Quality, and will now be properly added into your collection!

0.description: Fixed an issue where the hitbox of nightmare mode aura would in some cases become too large and would make you target players or pets with this aura by clicking near them. This update requires a patch update.

5.description: Alembic of Infernal Power now has PvE Power instead of PvP Power in its Mythic Version.

0.description: Players will now have a minimum of 250 PvP power in bgs and arena.
Players will now have a minimum of 250 PvE power in normal / heroic Dungeons and flex raids.
You can no longer change primary stat when queued for a battleground.
Feather of Acients: Azeroth will now give you ALL azeroth flight paths (Silvermoon, Zul'Aman, ...) when TBC is active.
You can no longer use Isle of Quel'Danas fight path until the event is active.
Transfers: Transfering from Seasonal to Area 52 server will no longer copy Wildcard / Draft data.
3D Transmog: Changing your race or faction will no longer cause item pieces from transmog system to show up incorrectly.
LFG: Rejecting or missing out a group invite will no longer give dungeon deserter to the entire group.
Mystic Enchanting Altars now have a 30 minute cooldown, from 3 hours. Pending Restart and patch update.

1.description: Hephaestus is a vendor that allows you to recover some quest awards from quests you have completed throughout TBC. He is located within the Scryer/Aldor's tier.
Fixed an issue where Revitalize would trigger too often on Rejuvenation and Wild Growth. [Pending restart]
